rationale.complete: Round 1 (kernels, linearity, FD, Hawkes, mean field) and the pre-registered NE21/NE23 holdout run are done; per-period kernels, a hidden-state (unread-context) model and the H08 follow-up remain.
rationale.faithfulness: Kernels and Hawkes beat their nulls (C = 1), but no kick type is a validated linear propagator, the field/FDT mapping fails, the mean-field decay prediction fails, and the primary holdout prediction (C1) was falsified in the opposite direction.
rationale.usefulness: Nudges act only on the named agent after a lag of minutes, mentions act at once, and kickoffs don't change activity level: a near design rule for targeting nudges, with modest non-holdout evidence.

one_line: Nudges act only on their target, after minutes of delay; the hours-reversal holdout was falsified in reverse
